title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → AcademicTermRecord
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Student enrollment term. Term-level enrollment: enrolled indicator, academic standing, hours enrolled, enrollment status code.
Student level GPA. Term and cumulative GPA, hours attempted/earned/passed, quality points. By level and GPA type (institutional, transfer, overall).
Student sport participation. Athletic sport codes and eligibility for student-athletes. Linked by PIDM and term.

attribute_mappings.source: SHRLGPA.SHRLGPA_GPA (where GPA_TYPE_IND='I' for institutional, current term)
attribute_mappings.transformation: Term GPA. Match on PIDM + TERM + LEVL + GPA_TYPE.
Map Banner academic standing codes via STVASTD: 'GS'→'good_standing', 'PB'→'probation', 'SU'→'suspension', 'DL'→'deans_list', 'PL'→'presidents_list'. Institution-defined.
Map enrollment status (full/part time): 'FT'→'full_time', 'HT'→'half_time', 'QT'→'three_quarter_time', 'LT'→'less_than_half_time'. Via STVESTS.

attribute_mappings.source: SGRSPRT exists for this PIDM + TERM
attribute_mappings.transformation: true if student has a SGRSPRT record for this term.
Array of sport codes for this term (e.g., 'MBB', 'WVB', 'FTBL'). Via STVSPRT for descriptions.
